findings.highlight: "Aa-ah, you're all covered in snow. Bend down a little, Haruki-kun."
findings.evidenceJa:
「あ～あ、なんか湯気出てるよ。
ほら、ちょっと屈んで、春希くん」
findings.explanation: Takeya jokes that steam seems to rise from Haruki, while the English merely says he is covered in snow.
findings.japanese:
「あ～あ、なんか湯気出てるよ。
ほら、ちょっと屈んで、春希くん」
findings.todokanai: "Aa-ah, you're all covered in snow. Bend down a little, Haruki-kun."

findings.highlight: Regardless of whether or not her attitude is merely a facade, I have no choice but to accept her currently cheerful and carefree state as being authentic.
findings.evidenceJa:
その態度が、嘘だろうと本物だろうと、
俺の中の公式設定で『明るく屈託のない雪菜』を
受け入れるしかない。
findings.explanation: Haruki calls the bright, carefree Setsuna an 'official setting'; the English states that her present manner is the real her.
findings.japanese:
その態度が、嘘だろうと本物だろうと、
俺の中の公式設定で『明るく屈託のない雪菜』を
受け入れるしかない。
findings.todokanai: Regardless of whether or not her attitude is merely a facade, I have no choice but to accept her currently cheerful and carefree state as being authentic.

findings.highlight: she didn't even bring so much as a drink with her
findings.evidenceJa: 実際には飲み物にすら手を付けてなかったり
findings.explanation: Setsuna had a drink but had not touched even it, evidence that her distress left her unable to eat or drink. The English says she did not bring a drink, replacing the symptom with an irrelevant fact about what she carried.
findings.japanese:
『映画館と言えばポップコーンだよね』って言ってたのに、
実際には飲み物にすら手を付けてなかったりとか。
findings.todokanai: Despite having made a comment about not forgetting popcorn when going to the cinema, she didn't even bring so much as a drink with her when we went inside.

findings.highlight: the music department wanted to have a feature article done
findings.evidenceJa: 急遽、音楽誌の方でも特集を組むことになった
findings.explanation: A music magazine has abruptly decided to run its own feature. The English invents a generic music department, obscuring that Haruki is discussing a second publication and the concrete editorial assignment created by Kazusa's newsworthiness.
findings.japanese:
「先月の開桜グラフに載ってた冬馬が凄い反響でさ。
急遽、音楽誌の方でも特集を組むことになったんだ」
findings.todokanai: "The bit about Touma in last month's Kaiou Graph made some pretty big waves. It wasn't long until the music department wanted to have a feature article done on her."

findings.highlight: "Said person's quite sharp, you see. They immediately found out that I used to go to school with Touma and came to talk to me right after."
findings.evidenceJa:
「その人がかなりの切れ者でさ、
冬馬と俺が同級生だってすぐに見抜いて、
俺に振ってきた」
findings.explanation: Mari recognized that Haruki attended Kazusa's old school and consequently put him on the biographical portion; the English says only that she found out and spoke to him.
findings.japanese:
「その人がかなりの切れ者でさ、
冬馬と俺が同級生だってすぐに見抜いて、
俺に振ってきた」
findings.todokanai: "Said person's quite sharp, you see. They immediately found out that I used to go to school with Touma and came to talk to me right after."

findings.highlight: It might look like I'm not putting much thought into it
findings.evidenceJa: 突き放してるように見せかけて、実は、慎重に、慎重に言葉を選び。
findings.explanation: Haruki is deliberately making it look as though he is pushing Setsuna away while in fact selecting each word with extreme care. The English turns the apparent cold rejection into apparent thoughtlessness, erasing the manipulative strategy governing the entire exchange.
findings.japanese:
突き放してるように見せかけて、
実は、慎重に、慎重に言葉を選び。
findings.todokanai: It might look like I'm not putting much thought into it, but I'm choosing my words very, very carefully.

findings.highlight: I might ruin the mood if I tried doing something like that myself, but the couples around us don't seem embarrassed at all, paying no mind to our stares.
findings.evidenceJa:
俺にしてみればムードが削がれる気がするんだけど、
でも、どの彼も彼女も堂々としたもので、
俺や雪菜の視線なんか意に介してないようだった。
findings.explanation: Haruki resents couples whose public behavior spoils the atmosphere; the English instead says his own attempt would spoil it.
findings.japanese:
俺にしてみればムードが削がれる気がするんだけど、
でも、どの彼も彼女も堂々としたもので、
俺や雪菜の視線なんか意に介してないようだった。
findings.todokanai: I might ruin the mood if I tried doing something like that myself, but the couples around us don't seem embarrassed at all, paying no mind to our stares.

findings.highlight: After all, it happened to trigger a switch that reawakened memories long pastーmy switch, and likely her own as well.
findings.evidenceJa:
俺と、そして多分、自分自身も、
思い出に引き込むスイッチを押すために。
findings.explanation: Setsuna deliberately draws both of them into a shared memory; the English says the topic simply happened to trigger it.
findings.japanese:
俺と、そして多分、自分自身も、
思い出に引き込むスイッチを押すために。
findings.todokanai: After all, it happened to trigger a switch that reawakened memories long pastーmy switch, and likely her own as well.

findings.highlight: This is something that I can't just laugh off
findings.evidenceJa: それは、流さないといけない。特に、切り返すことだけは絶対にできない質問。
findings.explanation: Haruki says he has to let the question pass, especially because he absolutely cannot turn it back on Setsuna. The English says he cannot laugh it off, reversing his intended response before correctly translating the prohibition on asking it in return.
findings.japanese:
それは、流さないといけない。
特に、切り返すことだけは絶対にできない質問。
findings.todokanai: This is something that I can't just laugh off. More importantly, it's a question that I absolutely cannot ask her in return.

findings.highlight: There was the snow that hid the long-departed airplane during the tiny period of time when I had all traces of Setsuna's existence erased from my heart.
findings.evidenceJa:
ほんの一瞬だけ、
雪菜の存在を自分の中から消し去ったとき、
飛んでいく飛行機を覆い隠してくれた雪。
findings.explanation: Haruki looks for the plane currently flying away; the English calls it long departed.
findings.japanese:
ほんの一瞬だけ、
雪菜の存在を自分の中から消し去ったとき、
飛んでいく飛行機を覆い隠してくれた雪。
findings.todokanai: There was the snow that hid the long-departed airplane during the tiny period of time when I had all traces of Setsuna's existence erased from my heart.

findings.highlight: What we'll be forgetting is the day when the three of us came together
findings.evidenceJa: なかったことになるのは、俺たちが三人になる、その日から
findings.explanation: Haruki proposes erasing everything from the day the trio came into being onward, retaining only his earlier history with Setsuna, as the following narration explains. The English erases only that single day, losing the scope of his counterfactual two-person history.
findings.japanese:
「違うよ。
なかったことになるのは、
俺たちが三人になる、その日から」
findings.todokanai: "No. What we'll be forgetting is the day when the three of us came together."

findings.highlight: I send Setsuna even deeper into a trance with my passion-filled kiss
findings.evidenceJa: さっきより激しく、三年前よりもっと激しく、雪菜以上に切羽詰まった、情欲まみれのキス。
findings.explanation: The kiss is more intense than moments ago, more intense than three years ago, and Haruki is even more desperate than Setsuna, steeped in lust. The English invents an effect on Setsuna—sending her into a deeper trance—and deletes the comparison that exposes Haruki's own greater desperation.
findings.japanese:
さっきより激しく、三年前よりもっと激しく、
雪菜以上に切羽詰まった、情欲まみれのキス。
findings.todokanai: More intensely than just moments before, and much more intensely than I did three years ago, I send Setsuna even deeper into a trance with my passion-filled kiss.

findings.highlight: I want to smile and take comfort in knowing that the path I chose was the right one
findings.evidenceJa: 朝を迎えたとき、自分の選んだ道が正しかったって、心の底から安心して、微笑んでもらえるように。
findings.explanation: Haruki resolves to be gentle so that, when morning comes, Setsuna can feel relief from the bottom of her heart and smile, believing the path she chose was right. The English assigns the reassurance and smile to Haruki himself, reversing the object of his concern.
findings.japanese:
朝を迎えたとき、自分の選んだ道が正しかったって、
心の底から安心して、微笑んでもらえるように。
findings.todokanai: Once morning comes, I want to smile and take comfort in knowing that the path I chose was the right one.

findings.highlight: "The isolated and overly emotional Kazusa followed in the footsteps of the wild and equally emotional Youko, and chose not to restrict herself to Japan's musical world."
findings.evidenceJa:
『孤高で激情家のかずさは、
奔放で激情家の曜子同様、
日本の音楽界に収まりきらなかった』
findings.explanation: Kazusa and Youko did not fit within Japan's music world; the English says Kazusa chose not to restrict herself to it.
findings.japanese:
『孤高で激情家のかずさは、
奔放で激情家の曜子同様、
日本の音楽界に収まりきらなかった』
findings.todokanai: "The isolated and overly emotional Kazusa followed in the footsteps of the wild and equally emotional Youko, and chose not to restrict herself to Japan's musical world."

findings.highlight: Her swollen eyes are, without a doubt, a result of a particular thing that was left on the side of the bed.
findings.evidenceJa:
きっと、泣き腫らした目が、
ベッドの脇に置かれた『それ』に注がれてた。
findings.explanation: Setsuna's swollen eyes are fixed on the magazine, while the English says the magazine caused the swelling.
findings.japanese:
きっと、泣き腫らした目が、
ベッドの脇に置かれた『それ』に注がれてた。
findings.todokanai: Her swollen eyes are, without a doubt, a result of a particular thing that was left on the side of the bed.

findings.highlight: "Sorry… I forgot to close it."
findings.evidenceJa: 「ごめん…しまい忘れてた」
findings.explanation: Haruki forgot to put the magazine away; the English says he forgot to close it.
findings.japanese: 「ごめん…しまい忘れてた」
findings.todokanai: "Sorry… I forgot to close it."

findings.highlight: All memories fade away with time
findings.evidenceJa: どんな想いだって、いつか自然に消えてくよ
findings.explanation: Haruki claims that any feelings will eventually fade naturally. The English instead claims that all memories fade, which is precisely the proposition Setsuna later rejects: she distinguishes his continuing love from memories that cannot simply be erased.
findings.japanese:
「三年も経ったんだ…
どんな想いだって、いつか自然に消えてくよ」
findings.todokanai: "It's been three years already… All memories fade away with time."

findings.highlight: is now simply continuing to pile up
findings.evidenceJa: さっきまで街中に降り積もっていた雪は、今はただ、積もっているだけだった。
findings.explanation: The snow that had been falling and accumulating has stopped; now it merely lies accumulated. The English says it is continuing to pile up, reversing the change in weather at the emotional break and disrupting the chapter's snow progression.
findings.japanese:
さっきまで街中に降り積もっていた雪は、
今はただ、積もっているだけだった。
findings.todokanai: The snow that was piling up on the streets a while ago is now simply continuing to pile up.

findings.highlight: The next train for Line 3
findings.evidenceJa: ３番線、次の電車は０時５５分到着予定です。
findings.explanation: The announcement says the next train at platform 3 is due at 12:55. 番線 denotes a station platform or track, not a numbered railway line; the English gives passengers the wrong transport information.
findings.japanese:
「３番線、次の電車は０時５５分到着予定です。
本日の最終電車となります。
お乗り遅れのないようお願いします」
findings.todokanai: "The next train for Line 3 is scheduled to arrive at 12:55 AM. This will be the final train of the day. Please take care not to miss it."

findings.highlight: I don't want to think about coming to any kind of conclusion about all this, so I should have just stopped thinking about it altogether, but…
findings.evidenceJa:
考えたくない結論に辿り着くのが嫌で、
何も考えないようにしてたはずなのに。
findings.explanation: Haruki had been trying not to think because he feared the conclusion; the English recasts this as what he should have done.
findings.japanese:
考えたくない結論に辿り着くのが嫌で、
何も考えないようにしてたはずなのに。
findings.todokanai: I don't want to think about coming to any kind of conclusion about all this, so I should have just stopped thinking about it altogether, but…
